# Detached house for sale

> Sherry FitzGerald is truly delighted to bring 14 Weston Court to the market. A truly impressive five-bedroom detached family residence, ideally positioned at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in a mature and highly regarded residential setting in Lucan.

- Druh nabídky: sale
- Plocha: 198 m²
